mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agv (agv_id, current_location, status, battery_level, carrying_material, assigned_task, speed, last_update_time, ip_address, mac_address, is_online) VALUES (#{agvId}, #{currentLocation}, #{status}, #{batteryLevel}, #{carryingMaterial}, #{assignedTask}, #{speed}, #{lastUpdateTime}, #{ipAddress}, #{macAddress}, #{isOnline})
mapper.update: UPDATE agv SET current_location = #{currentLocation}, status = #{status}, battery_level = #{batteryLevel}, carrying_material = #{carryingMaterial}, assigned_task = #{assignedTask}, speed = #{speed}, last_update_time = #{lastUpdateTime}, ip_address = #{ipAddress}, mac_address = #{macAddress}, is_online = #{isOnline} WHERE agv_id = #{agvId}

UPDATE agv SET agv_id = #{agvId}, current_location = #{currentLocation}, status = #{status}, battery_level = #{batteryLevel}, carrying_material = #{carryingMaterial}, assigned_task = #{assignedTask}, speed = #{speed}, last_update_time = #{lastUpdateTime}, ip_address = #{ipAddress}, mac_address = #{macAddress}, is_online = #{isOnline} WHERE id = #{id}
